content.short: Typhon Wallet is a Cardano web and browser extension wallet for ADA, staking, NFTs, and user accounts.
content.description: Typhon Wallet is a Cardano web and browser extension wallet for sending, receiving, staking, and managing ADA and native assets. It supports NFTs, hardware wallets such as Ledger and Trezor, multiple accounts, pool delegation, and reward tracking from a user-friendly interface. Typhon is designed for everyday Cardano activity, giving users wallet controls, transaction history, staking information, and asset management without requiring a full-node setup or advanced technical knowledge to operate.
content.meta: Typhon Wallet typhon provides all the features you need to sail the Cardano blockchain. Explore Typhon Wallet on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
